content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for CHECK: private-vpc-encrypt-handshake-failure (ACME-prod). Severity: page. Route: private-controlplane. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/INC123456>
kevin: Acked the page — I'm on it.
kevin: Quick triage: running agent health check for acme-prod.
kevin: Command: `rdctl agent status --customer acme-prod` — shows 3/4 agents healthy, one UNKNOWN and flapping reconnects.
leo: I can take network/peering. I'll check BGP and peering stats.
pagerduty: Escalation scheduled to SRE (marta) in 2m.
marta: Picking this up from escalation. Kevin — brief handoff? What symptoms from customer?
samira-cs: ACME support: customers see intermittent 500s and TLS handshake failures hitting embed endpoints since ~07:12 UTC. They reported spikes on the dashboard and some failed API calls.
kevin: Tagging incident: private-controlplane, customer=acme-prod, region=eu-west-1.
leo: Running quick tcpdump on peering interface: `tcpdump -n -i eth0 'port 443'` — seeing repeated TLS alerts (unexpected record, alert 40) and ICMP "fragmentation needed" messages.
marta: Suspect PMTU or middlebox truncation after a recent kernel/OS change on the customer side. Steps: verify PMTU, check onprem agent logs, prepare fallback.
kevin: Agent logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T07:13:22Z agent[pid=984]: handshake error: tls: unexpected record
2026-03-14T07:13:23Z agent[pid=984]: reconnecting to controlplane
2026-03-14T07:13:24Z agent[pid=984]: connection established
```

leo: Traceroute shows a hop with ICMP frag-needed responding. Confirmed PMTU black hole on path.
marta: Mitigation options: (1) enable controlplane fallback route for this tenant to avoid the problem path, or (2) change edge TLS record fragmentation/MTU behaviour. Fallback is lower-risk and faster.
kevin: I'll apply fallback routing for ACME while we investigate root cause. Command: `rdctl routing set --customer acme-prod --route fallback-controlplane --reason \"PMTU blackhole\"`
incident-bot: Routing change submitted, awaiting bgp propagation and dataplane confirmation.
kevin: Pushing canary for a subset of sessions to verify.
samira-cs: Customer on call reports decreased errors after a minute. They confirm embeds functioning for a test user.
leo: After routing change, peering RSTs cease and agent heartbeats return to 4/4. Verified by `rdctl agent status --customer acme-prod`.
marta: Customer impact assessment: ~35% of requests experienced TLS handshake failures during a ~9 minute window (07:12–07:21 UTC). No user data corruption reported. Impacted endpoints: /v1/embed, /v1/generate for ACME-prod.
kevin: Current status: mitigated (controlplane traffic routed via fallback transit). Next steps: follow up with customer to check recent kernel/OS updates and MTU configs; add PMTU monitoring and an automated fallback trigger for similar signals.
leo: I'll open network ticket to vendor and gather pcap exports.
marta: I'll create a post-incident runbook entry and action item list: (A) PTMU monitor, (B) automated routing fallback, (C) runbook for TLS-handshake PMTU incidents. Creating INF-1427 for tracking.
kevin: I'm taking lead on the postmortem and will coordinate logs + timeline. Marta will assist with remediation tasks.
samira-cs: I'll draft the customer-facing timeline and include the mitigation steps. Please attach logs and timeline to the ticket.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident resolved (ack -> resolved). Incident duration: ~12 minutes. Tags: private-vpc, controlplane, tls, pmtu.
marta: Noting that we should consider a scheduled test for PMTU across our private peering fleet.
kevin: Closing active mitigation. I'll follow up with the PM once postmortem draft is ready.
samira-cs: Thanks all — customer satisfied with quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
